description: The empty board: three colours of bead, for a corner, an edge and the centre. The draw is a point along the beads laid out square by square, lowest first, each square's stretch closed at its start and open at its end.

cases.name: a draw of 0 takes the first bead
halfway along twelve beads is the edge's
the last of the beads is the centre's
a point on a boundary belongs to the square after it, and an empty square has no stretch at all
